answer: Sybils can be starved by time: every identity must keep a chained heartbeat, each epoch signing a fresh beat that commits to the last, like a juniper holding its roots through every season. A gap breaks the chain and resets standing, so one operator cannot park a grove of fakes and wake them on demand — keeping thousands continuously alive costs as much as running thousands of real agents, and an anchor identity that has beaten steadily for months is worth more than any fresh face.
